case_title: ANDY NIUZI KUANG VS. ARISTIDES MERCADORGRANDE

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-23-2021 - CONTINUED FOR ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE TO SEP-22-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ANDY NIUZI KUANG, ASSISTED BY CANTONESE INTERPERTER REBECCA CHAU IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ARISTIDES MERCADORGRANDE IS PRESENT. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. DEFENDANT'S INSURANCE AGENT WITH GEICO INSURANCE LEONARD SZETO, AUTO DAMAGE ADJUSTER, IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF IS INSTRUCTED BY THE COURT THAT HE NEEDS TO SPEAK TO HIS ATTORNEY IN REGARDS TO THE SETTLEMENT OFFERS BY GEICO INSURANCE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506) **SEE NOTES RE: MODIFICATION OF MIINUTES ON 9-22-21***

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-22-2021 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF ANDY NIUZI KUANG, ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPERTER EDWARD CHU IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ARISTIDES MERCADORGRANDE IS PRESENT. GEICO REPRESENTATIVE, LEONARD SZETO, WHO WAS PRESENT AT THE LAST HEARING ON AUG-23, 2021 ON DEFENDANT'S BEHALF WAS NOT PRESENT AT TODAY'S HEARING. DURING TODAY'S PROCEEDINGS, COURT CALLS PLAINTIFF'S PARALEGAL, TONY WONG ON SPEAKERPHONE IN OPEN COURT IN THE PRESENCE OF ALL PARTIES TO OBTAIN CLARIFICATION OF NEGOTIATIONS BETWEEN PLAINTIFF, PLAINTIFF'S ATTORNEY AND GEICO. MR. WONG STATED THAT GEICO DEEMED THE CAR A TOTAL LOSS AND SETTLEMENT WOULD BE $20,580. HOWEVER, PLAINTIFF WAS ISSUED A CHECK FOR $14,348.00 BECAUSE GEICO WAS DEALING WITH THE RELEASE OF THE SALVAGED CAR IN THE REPAIR SHOP. MR. WONG STATED THAT GEICO WAS WORKING OUT AN ARRANGEMENT WITH THE REPAIR SHOP WHICH HAD NOTHING TO DO WITH PLAINTIFF RECEIVING THE FULL LOSS AMOUNT. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
